channel.title: Tuoi Tre News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Tuoi Tre News (tuoitrenews.vn)

item.title: Vietnam’s Lam Dong approves $2.3bn expansion of alumina projects
item.description: Lam Dong Province in Vietnam’s Central Highlands has approved adjustments to expand two alumina projects, with a combined investment of VND59.855 trillion (US$2.3 billion), making them the largest projects ever undertaken in the province.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City to inaugurate COVID-19 memorial park next week
item.description: Ho Chi Minh City will inaugurate its COVID-19 memorial park on February 12, according to the city’s Department of Construction.

item.title: In show of support, Canada, France open consulates in Greenland
item.description: Canada and France, which both adamantly oppose Donald Trump’s wish to control Greenland, will open consulates in the Danish autonomous territory’s capital on Friday, in a strong show of support for the local government.

item.title: India lifts wheat stock limits as supplies rise
item.description: NEW DELHI -- India has lifted limits on the amount of wheat stocks that traders, wholesalers and retailers can hold, the government said in a statement on Thursday, citing comfortable domestic supplies and easing prices.

item.title: Weight-loss drugs, soft-drink tax curtail sugar consumption
item.description: DUBAI -- Sugar consumption is declining in the United States and Western Europe and is stagnating globally as higher taxes on soft drinks and the widening use of weight-loss drugs dampen demand, analysts and industry executives said.

item.title: Strong cold front expected to bring severe cold, snow risk in northern Vietnam
item.description: A powerful cold front is forecast to hit northern Vietnam around Saturday, bringing severe cold conditions, with mountainous areas facing the risk of frost and even snow, according to the national weather agency.

item.title: Undercover probe finds Australian pubs short-pouring beer
item.description: Australian undercover inspectors have found pubs fail to pour enough beer and other alcohol into customers' glasses for nearly a third of the drinks they serve.

item.title: Ho Chi Minh City police test drones to boost crime prevention
item.description: Ho Chi Minh City police on Wednesday conducted a pilot test of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) at the Saigon Hi-Tech Park, aiming to study their application to crime prevention, security management, and operational response across the city.

item.title: Taiwan’s Cathay Financial seeks deeper role in Vietnam’s new international financial center
item.description: Taiwan’s Cathay Financial Holdings has expressed strong interest in playing a deeper role in Vietnam’s newly established International Financial Center, signaling growing global attention to the Southeast Asian country’s ambitions to become a regional financial hub.
